answer.reason: The verses tell what happened to the king of Ai: he led his people out to battle, was captured alive, and was hanged.

clauses.english: went out to battle against Israel, not knowing of the ambush behind the city
clauses.quote: he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city

clauses.english: was taken alive and brought to Joshua
clauses.quote: the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua

clauses.english: was hanged on a tree and buried under a heap of stones at the city gate
clauses.quote: the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide

doubts: JOS 8:14 (going out to battle) and JOS 8:23 (capture) are close; the battle clause could be dropped for brevity.
